entities.summary: Yad Eliyahu Arena, known as the Menora Mivtachim Arena and formerly as the Nokia Arena for commercial reasons, is a large multi-purpose sports indoor arena located in southeastern Tel Aviv, Israel. It primarily hosts tennis matches, basketball games, and concerts.
